parts.name: Root
parts.description: The stateful tree container. Renders role="tree" and manages focus, expansion, selection, and actions for all items.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description: Controlled set of expanded branch ids. Bindable.

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: Initially expanded branch ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Controlled set of selected item ids. Bindable.

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Initially selected item ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of items affected by `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether items can be selected: 'none', 'single', or 'multiple'.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: 'toggle' adds and removes items from the selection; 'replace' makes plain interaction replace it.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: 'all' makes disabled items fully non-interactive; 'selection' keeps them focusable and actionable while blocking selection.

props.name: selectionPropagation
props.description: 'none' keeps selection flat; 'descendants' propagates selection through a subtree and marks partially selected ancestors as indeterminate.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Prevents the user from deselecting the last selected item.

props.name: items
props.description: Data collection for dynamic rendering; each entry is passed to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Static tree content, or a snippet rendered once per entry when `items` is provided.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Rendered when the tree has no items.

props.name: onExpandedKeysChange
props.description: Called when the set of expanded branches changes.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the item id when an item is activated via click or Enter.

props.name: itemTransition
props.description: Enter/exit transition applied to each item row on expand/collapse. Defaults to none.

props.name: context
props.description: Bindable handle exposing the tree state for advanced composition.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered tree element.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tree has no items.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus inside the tree should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the tree.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the tree.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-mode
dataAttributes.description: The active selection mode ('single' | 'multiple'); absent when selection is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-registration
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden container used to register item structure; not a styling target.

parts.name: Section
parts.description: Groups related top-level items under an optional header. Renders role="group".

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id for the section node. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Arbitrary data associated with the section.

props.name: items
props.description: Data collection for dynamic rendering; each entry is passed to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: The section header and items, or a snippet rendered once per entry when `items` is provided.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: A visual label for a section's items.

props.name: children
props.description: The header label content.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: A single tree node. Renders the flattened role="treeitem" row and exposes focus, hover, selection, and pressed state on it.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id used in the expansion, selection, and disabled key sets.

props.name: value
props.description: Arbitrary data associated with the item.

props.name: title
props.description: Human-readable title for the node, used as its text value.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Overrides the text used for typeahead matching.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item according to the root's `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: children
props.description: The row content (trigger, checkbox, label) and an optional `Tree.Children` subtree.

parts.name: Children
parts.description: Marks the nested subtree of an item. Its presence makes the parent expandible on first render and during SSR.

props.name: children
props.description: The nested `Tree.Item` nodes.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The text label of an item row; also labels the row for assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: The label content.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the label element.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: An explicit expand/collapse button for a branch. Only rendered when the item has children, and not part of arrow-key navigation.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger content, typically an expansion icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the branch is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed-when-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Always present; marks the trigger as a control whose pressed styling should follow the expanded state.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the trigger element.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: An explicit selection affordance for an item row, kept in sync with the tree selection (including indeterminate ancestors).

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the rendered checkbox. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: title
props.description: Native tooltip text for the checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: The checkbox content, typically a `Tree.CheckboxIndicator`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label when no visible label is associated.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the checkbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-checkbox
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the checkbox element.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: The visual mark inside a tree checkbox. Mounted while the checkbox is checked or indeterminate.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the indicator mounted even while the checkbox is unchecked.

props.name: children
props.description: The indicator content, typically a check or minus icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate (partially selected subtree).

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked (with `forceMount`).
